acceptance: routes.yml selects one renderer per artifact keyed to release content; assembly refuses mixed renderers (tests)
All dlv2-60 pre-deploy gates pass on an all-Astro candidate built from a release-candidate tag plus trunk
Preview deploy of that candidate with probes, receipt and a rollback-by-receipt drill to the last Sphinx artifact
Pre-deploy visual comparison of the assembled candidate exists; dev-loop-property-ledger visual row updated with the real guard and evidence
context: Because of D13 there is no mixed-version window in production. landing/shared stays until astro-site-54 because Sphinx keeps rendering every route until the release cutover.
description:
After dlv2-62, site-deploy is the only production writer. Extend routes.yml and assembly so the renderer is selected per artifact, not per route:
- Sphinx for every route until the latest release tag contains website/ and all migrated content.
- From that release on, Astro for every route: / and /docs/ from the release tag; /docs/dev/ and /blog/ from trunk; /results/ from the Explorer artifact plus corpus snapshot, each pinned by its own SHA and digest. The API reference is release-pinned.
Assembly must refuse a mixed-renderer artifact (D13), and this is covered by tests.

Keep every dlv2-60 gate: per-route source SHA, corpus SHA, artifact sha256, privacy, explorer-compat (both orders), corpus bijection, digest, cross-route link check, post-deploy probes, receipts, rollback-by-receipt.

Visual guard: dev-loop-property-ledger.md maps "Public-site visual acceptance" to site-deploy route and digest probes. Those prove availability and artifact identity, not layout. Name the real layout guard and its evidence: the required CI context for trunk renders, plus a visual capture of the assembled release-sourced candidate compared with the last production artifact before deploy. Update the ledger row to match.
